items.title: Google Cloud races to catch up in the AI deployment wars with Accenture deal
items.feed_excerpt: Google Cloud expands its enterprise AI push with Accenture, betting on forward-deployed engineers to drive adoption and overcome deployment bottlenecks.

items.title: Google’s revived nuclear power plant gets $1.9B loan from US government
items.feed_excerpt: Google said it would bring an Iowa nuclear power plant back from the dead. Now the plant's owner is getting a $1.9 billion loan from the U.S. Energy Department.

items.title: Chrome is now shipping updates every 2 weeks as AI changes the security landscape
items.feed_excerpt: Google is speeding up Chrome’s release schedule to ship security patches and new features faster.

items.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
items.feed_excerpt: The French AI lab has raised €3 billion at a €21 billion valuation in a Series D round led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe, and PSG Equity.
